messages:
kevin: Quick update 1: initiating a PARTIAL FREEZE for APAC release lane for 2 hours. Observed OOMs on dedicated-pool-apac-2 during canary throughput increase. Pause all new main->prod rollouts targeting apac region.
alyssa: Is this full freeze or regional only?
kevin: Regional only (APAC). Other regions continue. No merges for APAC-targeted pipelines. Emergency hotfixes allowed with signoff.
deploy-bot: Deploy controller: rollouts to apac region suspended by policy: reason=memory-pressure pool=dedicated-pool-apac-2.
oncall-runtime: watching node memory and pod OOMKills. Current OOM count: 7 in last 10m on node apac-2b. If >10 we'll shift canary traffic out.
paula: adding mitigation steps: 1) reduce canary traffic to 10% for apac, 2) fallback route to model-small for non-critical routes, 3) lower batch_size to 4 for apac inference pool.
kevin: posted the exact config snippet: 
```
canary:
  apac: traffic_percent: 10
runtime:
  inference:
    batch_size: 4
    model_fallback: model-small
```
alyssa: telemetry: heap growth visible on runtime pod apac-2b-runtime-3, attaching heapdump link: https://internal/storage/heap/apac-2b/heap-2026-03-24.hprof
oncall-runtime: running `kubectl describe pod apac-2b-runtime-3` shows repeated SIGKILL due to OOM. Collecting pprof and coredump now.
deploy-bot: Rollout policy: scheduled/automatic rollouts to apac blocked until freeze lifted or override by release-ops. Use /override-release with incident id.
kevin: exception process: use https://internal/release-ops/exceptions include justification + rollback plan + impact matrix. No ad-hoc merges without signoff.
paula: copy. Also flagging infra to consider increasing swap margin or buffer allocations on dedicated pools as a short-term stopgap.
alyssa: starting targeted canary with model-small and batch_size=4, will report p50/p95 in 12m.
oncall-runtime: if we see queue depth >1200 or OOMs persist after 20m, we'll failover canary to eu-west and revert apac canary traffic to steady-state.
kevin: summary for the thread: 1) partial regional freeze APAC 2h, 2) canary traffic ->10% + model-small fallback + batch_size=4, 3) hotfixes allowed w/ signoff, 4) rollouts blocked for APAC until cleared. Incident ticket #IR-2026-150 opened and linked. I'll post updates. :loudspeaker:
